about: Hearing the name while the duck walks (2026-11-01, R13). Synthetic overlay: oww/make_turn_mixes.py recordings/bg_motion_life2 OUT walk = the 8 held-out home calls (calls_200910) over 38 s of 10/30 16:01-16:11 walking audio (the non-overlapping 2 s windows of the 14 walk intervals, speech masked), at the same levels as the turn trials (m6 = live post-glue call level, p0, p6, clean, noise alone). Scorer oww/score_mixes.py, max over the two ears. v3 never saw these windows; v4 and v5 trained on them, so their numbers here are not held out.
lower_threshold_while_walking: DF + v3 at 0.3 would take 5/8 at the live level, but 32 s of walking alone already reaches 0.29: no margin can be set on this little audio.
finding: Walking is the hard case: 3 dB louder than turning in the median and 6 dB at p90 (heel strikes), and the turn front end (DF + v3 7/8 on turns) gives 2/8 here. Calls 1 and 6 score near 0 in every front end and model.
next: Minutes of walking audio from the always-on life capture during ordinary walks (any walks on 10/31 after the 20:03 offload are still on the A7Z card), split by walk for a held-out test; then a spotter trained on DeepFilterNet output with calls overlaid on walking noise at the live level.
